$comment: Hand-verified free-tier facts, one entry per catalog provider. Every fact carries the provider's own wording (quote), the page it was read from (url; readUrl when a machine-readable twin of the same page was the copy actually read) and the date it was read. Quotes are verbatim; the only edits are markup: table cells are joined with ' · ', a link keeps its words but not its address, and ' … ' marks an omission. Nothing here is inferred: where a provider does not publish something, it goes in 'unpublished', and where two of its own pages disagree, both facts stay and point at each other through 'conflictsWith'. scripts/check-free-tiers.ts re-reads every source each morning and reports any quote that has disappeared; it never edits this file. See docs/FREE_TIERS.md.

google.answer: Yes. New Gemini API accounts start on a free tier that covers many current Gemini models, with no payment card needed.
google.trainingNote: not in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK, where paid-tier data terms apply
google.whatsFree: Gemini Flash and Flash-Lite, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemma 4 and more, up to per-model limits

facts.statement: New accounts begin on the Free Tier, which gives access to some Gemini models up to each model's free rate limits.
facts.quote: New accounts begin on the Free Tier, which allows access to certain models in the Gemini API and AI Studio, up to the models' free tier rate limits.

facts.statement: The pricing page marks free-tier rates 'Free of charge' for Gemini 3.8, 3.7, 3.6 and 3.5 Flash, the Flash-Lite models, Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash, Gemini Embedding 2 and Gemma 4, among others.
facts.quote: Input price · Free of charge

facts.statement: Some models have no free tier at all, including Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and the Nano Banana image models, which the pricing page lists as 'Not available' on the free tier.
facts.quote: Input price · Not available

facts.statement: Google Cloud's $300 Welcome credit and free trial cannot be spent on the Gemini API.
facts.quote: No, the Google Cloud Welcome credit or free trial credit can't be used towards the Gemini API or AI Studio.

facts.statement: No card is needed for the free tier. Moving to the paid tier means linking a billing account and prepaying at least $5.
facts.quote: Upgrading from the Free Tier to the Paid Tier means linking a billing account and prepaying to add a minimum of $5 (or equivalent in other currencies) of credits to your account.

facts.statement: The only requirement listed for the free tier is an active project or free trial.
facts.quote: Free · Active project or free trial · N/A

facts.statement: Free-tier request and token limits are shown in Google AI Studio, not in the public documentation.
facts.quote: Rate limits depend on a variety of factors (such as your usage tier) and can be viewed in Google AI Studio.

facts.statement: Grounding answers with Google Search is free for 500 requests a day on Gemini 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash-Lite (a shared limit). The newer Gemini 3.x models list it as not available on the free tier, and Pro models do not offer it free.
facts.quote: Grounding with Google Search · Free of charge, up to 500 RPD (limit shared with Flash-Lite RPD)

facts.statement: On the free tier, Google uses your prompts and its responses to improve its products and machine-learning technologies.
facts.quote: When you use Unpaid Services, including, for example, Google AI Studio and the unpaid quota on Gemini API, Google uses the content you submit to the Services and any generated responses to provide, improve, and develop Google products and services and machine learning technologies

facts.statement: People at Google may read free-tier prompts and responses, and Google asks you not to send anything sensitive.
facts.quote: To help with quality and improve our products, human reviewers may read, annotate, and process your API input and output. … Do not submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to the Unpaid Services.

facts.statement: In the European Economic Area, Switzerland and the UK, the paid-tier data terms apply even to free use.
facts.quote: If you're in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom, the terms under "How Google uses Your Data" in "Paid Services" apply to all Services, including Google AI Studio and unpaid quota

facts.statement: An app offered to users in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK must use the paid tier.
facts.quote: You may use only Paid Services when making API Clients available to users in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom.

facts.statement: Limits rise with spend: Tier 1 needs a linked billing account, Tier 2 needs $100 paid and 3 days, Tier 3 needs $1,000 paid and 30 days (counted across all Google Cloud spend on the linked billing account).
facts.quote: Tier 2 · Paid $100 + 3 days from first successful payment

unpublished: Free-tier requests per minute, tokens per minute and requests per day for each model. Google shows these only inside AI Studio.

facts.quote: Free mode: API access is enabled by default with no credit card required. Usage and rate limits apply.

facts.statement: Free mode is where every new account starts.

facts.statement: The Free plan includes $10 a month in API credits.

facts.statement: Calls made with a trial key are free, but trial keys are rate-limited and not allowed for production or commercial use.
facts.quote: API calls made from a Trial API key are free. However, trial keys are rate limited and are not permitted to be used for production or commercial purposes.

facts.statement: A trial key is created for you automatically when you open an account.
facts.quote: When an account is created, we automatically create an Trial API key for you.

facts.statement: Every Cohere model and API can be tried with a trial key.
facts.quote: Developers wanting to test different applications or build proofs of concept can use all of Cohere's models and APIs can do so with a trial key

facts.statement: Cohere's privacy policy defines trial users as having no payment method on file.
facts.quote: Trial Users : Individuals who create or access a free trial account to test out our Platform under our standard Terms of Use with no payment method on file.

facts.statement: Trial keys are capped at 1,000 API calls a month.
facts.quote: Trial keys (and prod keys on newer Chat model variants) are limited to 1,000 API calls a month.

facts.statement: On a trial key, Command A allows 20 requests a minute, against 500 on a production key.
facts.quote: Command A · 20 req / min · 500 req / min

facts.statement: The rate-limits page gives the trial Embed limit as 2,000 inputs a minute.

facts.statement: For trial users, Cohere collects what you send and what its models return, and may use it for research and development.

Token-per-minute limits. Only requests or inputs per minute are published.

alibaba.answer: A one-time allowance, not an ongoing free tier. New Model Studio users get a free token quota per model, valid for 90 days, then pay as they go.
alibaba.whatsFree: Typically 1 million tokens per participating model for 90 days, Singapore (International) only

facts.statement: Each model has its own free quota, typically 1,000,000 tokens, which cannot be combined or moved between models.
facts.quote: Each model (such as qwen-plus, qwen3.6-plus, or qwen3.6-plus-2026-04-02) has its own independent free quota (typically 1,000,000 tokens). Quota cannot be merged or transferred across models.

facts.statement: The quota lasts 90 days from activation, the model's release or approval of your request, whichever is latest.
facts.quote: The free quota is valid for 90 days, starting from the date you activate Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, the model is released, or your model request is approved (whichever is later).

facts.statement: When the quota runs out you are billed automatically, unless you have switched on 'Free Quota Only' beforehand.
facts.quote: After the free quota is exhausted, you are automatically billed on a pay-as-you-go basis. To avoid unexpected charges, enable [Free Quota Only] in advance so that the service stops when the quota runs out.

facts.statement: The quota covers ordinary real-time calls only, not batch jobs, fine-tuning or deployments.
facts.quote: The free quota only covers charges for real-time inference (invocations).

facts.statement: Not every model takes part. Alibaba says to check each model's details page in the console.
facts.quote: Some models do not participate in the new user free quota program. To check whether a specific model is eligible for a free quota, go to the Model Gallery page in the console and open that model's details page.

facts.statement: You must complete your account information before activating Model Studio and receiving the quota. The page links that step to mobile-number verification.
facts.quote: You must [complete your account information] before you can activate Model Studio. After completing your information, you can activate Model Studio, receive a free quota, and start your free trial.

facts.statement: Alibaba Cloud's general sign-up guide lists a payment method as part of completing sign-up.
facts.quote: Complete sign-up · Mobile number, payment method, billing address, tax information (optional)

facts.statement: The same guide's table shows that activating a free trial is not supported until sign-up is complete.
facts.quote: Activate a free trial · Unsupported · Supported

facts.statement: Free and paid calls run on the same infrastructure at the same generation speed.
facts.quote: Free quota and paid calls use the same Model service infrastructure, and the generation speed of the same Model is identical.

facts.statement: Without separate consent, Alibaba does not use your inputs, outputs or files to train its models.
facts.quote: Without your separate consent, we will not use your business data (including inputs, outputs, and files) to train, fine-tune or improve any foundation model.

facts.statement: Only models in the Singapore region with International deployment get the free quota.
facts.quote: Only models in the Singapore region with the service deployment scope set to [International] are eligible for a free quota.

facts.statement: Topping up does not raise rate limits; higher limits are arranged separately.
facts.quote: Top Up does not change the model's default RPM and TPM rate limit thresholds.

unpublished: Whether a payment method must be on file to activate the free quota. Alibaba's two pages on this point differ.

Default Bedrock request and token limits for a brand-new account. AWS publishes them per model in Service Quotas.

facts.statement: Limits rise automatically with total spend: Tier 1 at $5, up to Tier 5 at $1,000.
